src: Deck lists from MTGJSON (via taw/magic-preconstructed-decks-data); strategy notes by Claude

decks.name: Black Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Villains and removal. Tombstone makes Villains cheaper and returns one from your graveyard, Black Widow drains for every creature card in your graveyard, and Ultimo makes them sacrifice a creature, even straight from your hand. Doom Blade, Dark Deed and Hour of Defeat clear the way.

decks.name: Blue Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Artifacts and flyers. Iron Man pumps your other artifact creatures and draws when he attacks, Lyla adds a counter whenever you draw, Blue Marvel grows on your second draw each turn, and Alchemax Slayer-Bots stun a blocker.

decks.name: Green Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Gamma-powered brawlers. Hulk attacks every turn and grows the rest of your team, Goliath powers up to draw cards, She-Hulk grows and smashes artifacts, and Kapow! and Thing Swing let your big creatures fight.

decks.name: Red Welcome Deck
decks.plan: All-out attacks. Rampaging Classmate grows for every other attacker, The Mary Janes cost less for each creature that attacked, Living Lightning gives an ally haste each combat, and Sif's Spearmaster pings the opponent every turn.

decks.name: White Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Heroes who attack alone. Black Panther puts a counter and Peggy Carter puts indestructible on a lone attacker, Mockingbird grows whenever she survives damage, and Doctor Jane Foster brings a creature back. Fall to Earth exiles their biggest threat.

decks.name: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
decks.plan: S.H.I.E.L.D. agents who reward attacking alone: Nick Fury draws and cheats in a creature, Peggy Carter keeps the lone attacker alive.

decks.name: Analyzed
decks.plan: Synthezoids and androids that draw and stall, with counterspells and Frozen in Ice.

decks.name: Animal
decks.plan: The Pet Avengers: Lucky the Pizza Dog, Tippy-Toe and friends, with Savage Land Dinosaur as muscle.

decks.name: Armed
decks.plan: Villains with weapons: Equipment like HYDRA Disintegrator and Voltaic Whip on menacing attackers.

decks.name: Atlantis
decks.plan: Namor and the Atlanteans attack from the sea; Atlantis Attacks brings the tide.

decks.name: Battalion
decks.plan: Soldiers and teamwork: War Machine, Captain America and the Howling Commandos fight together.

decks.name: Blink
decks.plan: Creatures that leave and come back for value, around the Silver Surfer.

decks.name: Boosted
decks.plan: Power-ups and pump: Human Torch, Wonder Man and HULK SMASH!

decks.name: Caretakers
decks.plan: Healers and protectors: Night Nurse and Doctor Strange keep your heroes alive.

decks.name: Conniving
decks.plan: Villains that connive and plot, led by Doc Ock.

decks.name: Counterargument
decks.plan: Lawyers and allies: Matt Murdock and She-Hulk, Attorney-at-Law argue the case with +1/+1 counters.

decks.name: DOOM
decks.plan: Doctor Doom and his Doombots, with Dark Ritual, Doom Blade and Doomsday.

decks.name: Equipped
decks.plan: Captain America and his allies with the Shield and other gear.

decks.name: Fantastic
decks.plan: The Fantastic Four, each bringing their own power.

decks.name: Fearless
decks.plan: Daredevil, Elektra and the street-level heroes of Hell's Kitchen.

decks.name: Geniuses
decks.plan: The smartest heroes: Reed Richards, Shuri and Blue Marvel turn cards into advantage.

decks.name: Great Lakes Avengers
decks.plan: Squirrel Girl and the Great Lakes Avengers, more capable than they look.

decks.name: Heroes for Hire
decks.plan: Luke Cage, Iron Fist and Misty Knight for hire.

decks.name: HYDRA
decks.plan: HYDRA agents that grow in number, led by Baron Strucker.

decks.name: Incredible
decks.plan: The Hulk family: grow counters and double them.

decks.name: Iron Man
decks.plan: Iron Man and his suits: artifacts that make each other stronger.

decks.name: Kang Dynasty
decks.plan: Kang's many selves bend time; Time Warp takes an extra turn.

decks.name: Lethal
decks.plan: Black Widows and assassins with deathtouch and removal.

decks.name: Marvelous
decks.plan: The Captains Marvel and Ms. Marvel fly in with big power.

decks.name: Masters of Evil
decks.plan: The Masters of Evil team up their villains.

decks.name: Mayhem
decks.plan: Green Goblin and friends throw bombs and cause chaos.

decks.name: Precise
decks.plan: Hawkeye and the sharpshooters: targeted spells and stun counters.

decks.name: Pym Particles
decks.plan: Ant-Man and the Wasp shrink and grow with Pym Particles.

decks.name: Rampaging
decks.plan: Rhino and the brutes trample everything in their way.

decks.name: Returned
decks.plan: Villains that return from the dead, with Ultimo and the Grim Reaper.

decks.name: Runaways
decks.plan: The Runaways, a five-color team of kids with powers.

decks.name: Savage Lands
decks.plan: Dinosaurs of the Savage Land, with Devil Dinosaur and Ka-Zar.

decks.name: Scarlet
decks.plan: The Scarlet Witch and Vision with burn and spells.

decks.name: Soaring
decks.plan: Flyers: Falcon, Rescue and drones take to the skies.

decks.name: Speedy
decks.plan: Speedsters with haste: Quicksilver, Speed and the Whizzer.

decks.name: Spider-Verse
decks.plan: Spider-people from across the multiverse.

decks.name: Squadron
decks.plan: The Squadron Supreme, led by Hyperion.

decks.name: Street Level Villains
decks.plan: Kingpin and the crime bosses of New York.

decks.name: Tenacious
decks.plan: Scrappy heroes that keep coming back, like Hellcat.

decks.name: Thor
decks.plan: Thor and the Asgardians, with lightning.

decks.name: Thunderbolts
decks.plan: The Thunderbolts: villains posing as heroes.

decks.name: Towering
decks.plan: Giants: heroes who grow huge.

decks.name: Trained
decks.plan: Martial artists like Shang-Chi and White Tiger.

decks.name: Tricksters
decks.plan: Loki and the tricksters copy and deceive.

decks.name: Ultron
decks.plan: Ultron's robot army.

decks.name: Uncanny
decks.plan: The X-Men: Wolverine, Storm and Colossus.

decks.name: Vehicles
decks.plan: Vehicles and the villains who drive them.

decks.name: Wakanda
decks.plan: Black Panther and the Dora Milaje defend Wakanda.

decks.name: Web-Slinging
decks.plan: Spider-Man and his friends: Aunt May, Flash Thompson and Spider-Girl.

decks.name: Wild
decks.plan: Savage heroes: Hellcat, Hit-Monkey and Ka-Zar.

decks.name: Young Avengers
decks.plan: The Young Avengers team up.

decks.name: Avengers Assemble
decks.plan: Captain America, Team Leader gives every Hero that joins vigilance, haste and a +1/+1 counter, and grows himself each time. Assemble the Avengers, from Iron Man to the Wasp, and attack together.

decks.name: Doom Prevails
decks.plan: Doctor Doom, King of Latveria makes a Villain connive every combat and drains each opponent whenever you discard lands. Kang, Ultron and the Masters of Evil scheme until Doom rules.

decks.name: The Fantastic Four
decks.plan: Invisible Woman builds Walls when you cast noncreature spells, and with all four colors she can make one creature huge and unblockable. Reed, Johnny and Ben join her, with Galactus waiting at the top.

decks.name: Wakanda Forever
decks.plan: T'Challa makes Vibranium whenever he enters or attacks and grows each time you cast a big artifact. Okoye, Shuri and Wakanda's technology defend the nation.

decks.name: Blue-Black Starter Kit
decks.plan: The villains of FINAL FANTASY. Trade early with Dire Rats and Cie'th that keep coming back, kill threats with Sephiroth's Intervention and Overkill, then land a legend that ends it: Sephiroth shrinks their board, Ultimecia taps it all down and draws on every hit, and Xande grows with every spell in your graveyard.

decks.name: Red-White Starter Kit
decks.plan: Heroes and their gear. Load creatures with Swords, Katanas and Lances, then let Cloud, who has double strike and indestructible on your turn while equipped, carry them. Beatrix moves every Equipment onto one creature each combat, Rosa adds counters and lifelink, and Ultima Weapon destroys a creature with every attack.

decks.name: Counter Blitz (FINAL FANTASY X)
decks.plan: Tidus moves +1/+1 counters to where they matter each combat, and every time your countered creatures connect he draws and proliferates. Yuna's Summons and Auron add counters to spread.

decks.name: Limit Break (FINAL FANTASY VII)
decks.plan: Cloud, Ex-SOLDIER comes in with haste and an Equipment, then draws a card for every equipped attacker and makes Treasure once he's huge. Tifa, Vincent and the materia gear make every attack count.

decks.name: Revival Trance (FINAL FANTASY VI)
decks.plan: Terra, Herald of Hope mills two each combat and flies in; when she connects, she brings back a small creature from your graveyard. The Returners keep dying and returning until they win.

decks.name: Scions & Spellcraft (FINAL FANTASY XIV)
decks.plan: Y'shtola drains 2 from each opponent whenever you cast a big noncreature spell, and draws when a player loses 4 life in a turn. The Scions keep the spells flowing.

decks.name: Gondor: Green-White
decks.plan: Legends of the Fellowship. Aragorn and Arwen grow your whole team every time they enter or attack, Galadriel hands out counters, Food or Treasure, and Gandalf pumps your creatures whenever you cast a spell. Frodo picks up Bilbo's Ring or a Dúnedain Blade, and Banishing Light handles whatever you can't fight.

decks.name: Mordor: Black-Red
decks.plan: The forces of Mordor. Orcs and Goblins amass armies, Sauron steals a blocker for a turn and drains every turn after, the Witch-king makes them sacrifice their smallest creature each attack, and the Balrog tramples over for 7. Feed the Swarm and Fires of Mount Doom clear the way.

decks.name: Courageous 1
decks.plan: Halflings that go wide. Saradoc turns every small creature into two bodies, Rosie Cotton grows a creature whenever you make a token, and Esquire of the King pumps the whole team late. Fog on the Barrow-Downs and Lost to Legend handle the one big threat.

decks.name: Courageous 2
decks.plan: The same Halfling swarm with more tricks: Nimble Hobbit taps a blocker when it attacks, Eastfarthing Farmer turns Food into a pump, and Hobbit's Sting deals damage equal to your creatures plus your Foods. Bill the Pony brings two Foods of its own.

decks.name: Cunning 1
decks.plan: A patient blue pack that draws and stalls. Minas Tirith Garrison is as strong as your hand is big and taps Humans to draw even more; Captain of Umbar loots, Glorious Gale counters a creature and Bewitching Leechcraft locks down an attacker. Horses of the Bruinen clears two blockers for the final push.

decks.name: Cunning 2
decks.plan: Card draw and tempo: Lórien Revealed and Mirror of Galadriel refill your hand to power up Minas Tirith Garrison, Elrond scries as your creatures enter, and Isolation at Orthanc puts a threat back on top of its owner's library.

decks.name: Elven 1
decks.plan: Elves that scry. Lothlórien Lookout, Galadhrim Guide and Celeborn scry again and again, every scry grows Chance-Met Elves and Glorfindel, and Mirkwood Channeler gives an Elf +X/+X and trample for each Forest. Shower of Arrows answers flyers.

decks.name: Elven 2
decks.plan: Scrying Elves with more muscle: Quickbeam gives two attackers +2/+2 and trample, Mirkwood Spider brings deathtouch, and Ent-Draught Basin keeps adding counters. Bombadil's Song protects your best Elf from removal.

decks.name: Journey 1
decks.plan: Food on the road. Elanor Gardner, Brandywine Farmer and Meriadoc make Food, and each turn you eat one Elanor fetches a land. Mirrormere Guardian and Dúnedain Rangers keep the Ring tempting you; Ent's Fury and Gift of Strands win the fights.

decks.name: Journey 2
decks.plan: A Food engine: Peregrin Took adds a Food to every batch of tokens, Pippin's Bravery turns a Food into +4/+4, and Galadhrim Bow ambushes attackers with flash. Elanor turns eaten Food into lands for Quickbeam.

decks.name: Marauders 1
decks.plan: Orc armies and burn. Swarming of Moria, Foray of Orcs and Grishnákh amass Orcs, Erebor Flamesmith pings with every spell, and Assault on Osgiliath gives every Goblin and Orc double strike and haste for a sudden kill.

decks.name: Marauders 2
decks.plan: Faster Orcs: Goblin Fireleaper and Rush the Room push early damage, Smite the Deathless clears a blocker for good, and Assault on Osgiliath ends it with double strike.

decks.name: Mordor 1
decks.plan: The Ring tempts you again and again. Nazgûl, Uruk-hai Berserker and Claim the Precious tempt you; Ringwraiths shrinks a creature by 3 and comes back from the graveyard whenever you're tempted, and Gothmog gives your tokens deathtouch.

decks.name: Mordor 2
decks.plan: Ringwraiths with a sacrifice engine: Gríma Wormtongue drains for each creature you sacrifice, Nasty End and Lash of the Balrog turn spare creatures into cards and removal, and Bitter Downfall kills a damaged creature cheaply.

decks.name: Mortals 1
decks.plan: Soldiers that protect each other. Eagle of Deliverance makes a small creature indestructible and draws a card, Shire Shirriff and Banish from Edoras remove threats, Éowyn grants first strike or vigilance each combat, and Faramir draws when your creatures die.

decks.name: Mortals 2
decks.plan: Knights and flyers: East-Mark Cavalier destroys any Goblin or Orc it damages, Landroval gives an attacker flying, and Eagle of Deliverance protects your best small creature. Reprieve and Slip On the Ring save the day.

decks.name: Orcish 1
decks.plan: An ever-growing Orc Army. Warg Rider amasses two every combat and gives your Orcs menace, Mordor Muster and Dunland Crebain add more, Gothmog gives tokens deathtouch, and Grond rolls in once you control an Army.

decks.name: Orcish 2
decks.plan: The Army with siege engines: Mordor Trebuchet makes flying Ballistas whenever Orcs attack, March from the Black Gate amasses each time your Army attacks, and Voracious Fell Beast makes them sacrifice a creature.

decks.name: Riders 1
decks.plan: Humans that hit hard and fast. Rally at the Hornburg and Rohirrim Lancer build a team, Erkenbrand pumps it whenever a Human enters, and Riders of the Mark costs less for each Human, attacks with haste and trample, then goes back to hand leaving four Soldiers behind.

decks.name: Riders 2
decks.plan: The Rohirrim with gear: Gimli's Axe and Haradrim Spearmaster add power, Book of Mazarbul builds an Army, and Riders of the Mark comes back turn after turn.

decks.name: Tricksy 1
decks.plan: Scry to tap blockers. Elvish Mariner scries when it attacks and taps a nonland permanent each time you scry; Nimrodel Watcher can't be blocked after a scry, and Willow-Wind and Council's Deliberation give you more scries.

decks.name: Tricksy 2
decks.plan: Saruman's spells: Saruman the White amasses Orcs whenever you cast your second spell in a turn, Saruman's Trickery counters and amasses, Elvish Mariner taps blockers and Ithilien Kingfisher draws when it dies.

decks.name: Arcane Aggression
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): blue and red spells with Tolarian Terror.

decks.name: Charging Ahead
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): red and green Dragons and big creatures.

decks.name: Grave Secrets
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): blue and black graveyard tricks.

decks.name: Growing Hope
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): white and green counters and tokens.

decks.name: High-Flying Valor
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): white and blue soldiers and flyers.

decks.name: Legions of Phyrexia
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): white and black oil counters.

decks.name: Rebel Armory
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): white and red Equipment.

decks.name: Savage Salvagers
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): black and green graveyard value.

decks.name: Scrapyard Sacrifice
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): black and red sacrifice.

decks.name: Sylvan Wisdom
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter (2023): blue and green Elves that scry, with Arwen and Celeborn.

decks.name: Elven Council
decks.plan: Galadriel, Elven-Queen rewards a steady stream of Elves: whenever another Elf has entered, the table votes, and either the Ring tempts you and your Ring-bearer grows, or you scry and draw. Elrond, Legolas and Haldir keep the council full.

decks.name: Food and Fellowship
decks.plan: Frodo and Sam as partners: Sam makes a Food every combat and makes Food cheaper to eat, and Frodo turns the life you gain into Ring temptations and cards. Treebeard, Gaffer and Bilbo keep the Shire's party going.

decks.name: Riders of Rohan
decks.plan: Éowyn, Shieldmaiden makes two hasty 2/2 Human Knights every combat after another Human enters, and draws once you control six Humans. Go wide with soldiers, then ride in with Aragorn, Éomer and Forth Eorlingas!

decks.name: The Hosts of Mordor
decks.plan: Sauron, Lord of the Rings arrives with an Army of five Orcs, fills your graveyard and brings a creature back. Saruman and the Lord of the Nazgûl keep the Orcs coming until Mordor overruns the table.

decks.name: Spellslinger Black-Green
decks.plan: Huge green creatures with black removal. Llanowar Elves ramp, Ghalta comes down for almost nothing once your board is big, Verdant Sun's Avatar gains life for every creature, and Ravenous Chupacabra and Impale kill their best threat. Declare Dominance forces everything to block one giant.

decks.name: Spellslinger Red-White
decks.plan: Fast flyers and burn. Skyknight Legionnaire, Sky Terror and Exultant Skymarcher attack in the air, Lightning Strike and Dual Shot clear blockers, and Demanding Dragon and Burning Sun's Avatar finish with damage. Citywide Bust wipes out their big creatures, not yours.

decks.name: Black Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Graveyard value. Gravedigger and Gravewaker bring creatures back, Vampire Sovereign drains 3 when it enters, and Murder, Lich's Caress and Strangling Spores clear the way.

decks.name: Blue Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Flyers and tricks. Snapping Drakes and Air Elemental attack in the air, Aven Wind Mage grows with every spell, Waterknot and Sleep lock down blockers, and Riddlemaster Sphinx bounces their best creature.

decks.name: Green Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Big creatures early. Llanowar Elves ramp into Colossal Dreadmaw and Ghastbark Twins, who can block two attackers; Bristling Boar can't be blocked by more than one creature, and Titanic Growth and Rabid Bite win the fights.

decks.name: Red Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Dragons and burn. Kargan Dragonrider flies once you control a Dragon, Sparktongue Dragon can shoot 3 damage, Shivan Dragon pumps itself, and Shock, Lightning Strike and Radiating Lightning clear blockers or finish the game.

decks.name: White Welcome Deck
decks.plan: Flyers and pump spells. Pegasus Courser gives another attacker flying, Star-Crowned Stag taps a blocker each time it attacks, and Inspired Charge and Mighty Leap push damage through. Luminous Bonds and Take Vengeance deal with what blocks.

decks.name: Ajani
decks.plan: Ajani, Wise Counselor leads a white life-gain deck: Ajani's Pridemate grows whenever you gain life.

decks.name: Liliana
decks.plan: Liliana, Untouched by Death leads a black Zombie deck with Arisen Gorgon and Demon of Catastrophes.

decks.name: Sarkhan
decks.plan: Sarkhan, Dragonsoul leads red Dragons: Kargan Dragonriders fly once you control one.

decks.name: Tezzeret
decks.plan: Tezzeret, Cruel Machinist leads blue artifacts with Tezzeret's Strider and Riddlemaster Sphinx.

decks.name: Vivien
decks.plan: Vivien of the Arkbow leads green fighters: Rabid Bite and big creatures such as Ghastbark Twins.

decks.name: Arcane Inventions
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: blue artifacts with Sai, Master Thopterist and Tempest Djinn.

decks.name: Artifacts Attack
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: white and blue artifacts with Juggernaut, Skyscanners and Azor.

decks.name: Auras of Majesty
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: white and green auras on Knights; Danitha Capashen makes them cheaper.

decks.name: Chaos and Mayhem
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: Act of Treason steals a creature, then sacrifice it for value.

decks.name: Dragon's Fire
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: red Dragons and burn.

decks.name: Eternal Thirst
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: white and black life gain with Ajani's Pridemate and Epicure of Blood.

decks.name: Forest's Might
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: green stompy topped by Gigantosaurus.

decks.name: Graveyard Bash
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: black Zombies around Death Baron.

decks.name: Jungle Secrets
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: blue and green Merfolk.

decks.name: Primal Fury
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: red and green Dinosaurs, led by Goreclaw.

decks.name: Saproling Swarm
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: black and green Saprolings with Slimefoot.

decks.name: Strength in Numbers
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: white and red tokens; Heroic Reinforcements makes two soldiers and swings.

decks.name: Tactical Assault
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: white weenies with Leonin Warleader.

decks.name: Walk the Plank
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: blue and black Pirates.

decks.name: Wrath of Mages
decks.plan: MTG Arena starter: blue and red spells with Guttersnipe.

decks.name: Illusionary Might
decks.plan: Tournament-ready white-blue: Phantasmal Bears and Dragons hit hard, Mana Leak and Mind Control keep the game yours.

decks.name: Vampire Onslaught
decks.plan: Tournament-ready black vampires: Vampire Nighthawk, Bloodghast and Kalastria Highborn, with Dismember and Gatekeeper of Malakir.

decks.name: Blood and Fire
decks.plan: Black and red bloodthirst: Shock and Goblin Fireslinger enable Bloodrage Vampire and Stormblood Berserker.

decks.name: Entangling Webs
decks.plan: Red and green spiders: Arachnus Web and Giant Spiders hold the air while Stampeding Rhinos attack.

decks.name: Grab for Power
decks.plan: Blue and black Empires: assemble Crown and Scepter of Empires to steal a creature each turn, backed by Doom Blade.

decks.name: Mystical Might
decks.plan: White and blue flyers with illusions: Phantasmal Dragon and Skywinder Drakes, with Oblivion Ring for removal.

decks.name: Sacred Assault
decks.plan: White and green auras and Griffins: Spirit Mantle and Divine Favor pump attackers, and Pacifism clears blockers.

decks.name: Blades of Victory
decks.plan: White and black life gain and flyers: Ajani's Pridemate grows, Serra Angels and Cloud Crusaders attack, and Armored Ascension makes a huge flyer.

decks.name: Breath of Fire
decks.plan: Red and blue burn: Lightning Bolt, Chandra's Outrage and Chandra's Spitfire, with Fiery Hellhounds and Berserkers to attack.

decks.name: Power of Prophecy
decks.plan: White and blue card advantage: Foresee and Jace's Ingenuity draw, Sleep and Negate protect, and Air and Water Servants win.

decks.name: Reign of Vampirism
decks.plan: Black and green vampires that sacrifice for value: Viscera Seer, Bloodthrone Vampire and Royal Assassin, with Diabolic Tutor to find the best.

decks.name: Stampede of Beasts
decks.plan: Red and green beasts: Garruk's Packleader draws as big creatures enter, and Protean Hydra and Duskdale Wurm close.

decks.name: Death's Minions
decks.plan: Black and green removal with Cemetery Reaper making Zombies; Nightmare and Enormous Baloth finish.

decks.name: Firebomber
decks.plan: Red and blue burn: Lightning Bolt, Seismic Strike and Goblin Artillery clear the way for Shivan Dragon.

decks.name: Nature's Fury
decks.plan: Green and white creatures that end with Overrun: elves ramp into Enormous Baloth and Kalonian Behemoth.

decks.name: Presence of Mind
decks.plan: Blue and black tricks: Clone copies their best creature, Sleep taps their board, and Djinn of Wishes and Air Elemental win.

decks.name: We Are Legion
decks.plan: White and red weenies with Serra Angel on top; Pacifism and Harm's Way protect the attack.

decks.name: Arcanis's Guile
decks.plan: Blue control around Arcanis the Omnipotent: counter their spells with Cancel and Remove Soul, then let Arcanis draw three cards a turn.

decks.name: Cho-Manno's Resolve
decks.plan: White knights and flyers: Benalish Knights and Skyhunter Patrols attack, Cho-Manno takes no damage, and Pariah sends damage to a creature.

decks.name: Evincar's Tyranny
decks.plan: Black control: Ascendant Evincar shrinks their creatures, Mortivore and Mass of Ghouls grow late, and Cruel Edict and Mind Rot grind them down.

decks.name: Kamahl's Temper
decks.plan: Red aggression: Kamahl, Furnace Whelp and Thundering Giants attack while Incinerate, Spitting Earth and Beacon of Destruction burn.

decks.name: Molimo's Might
decks.plan: Green ramp: Rampant Growth and Civic Wayfinder find lands for Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer, Enormous Baloth and Craw Wurm.

decks.name: Army of Justice
decks.plan: White soldiers: Crossbow Infantry, Master Decoy and Ballista Squad control combat, Angels of Mercy gain life, and Glorious Anthem pumps everyone.

decks.name: Custom Creatures
decks.plan: Green auras: Verduran and Yavimaya Enchantress draw cards for every aura, and Blanchwood Armor and Treetop Bracers make huge attackers.

decks.name: Dead Again
decks.plan: Black recursion: Gravedigger and Raise Dead bring creatures back, Nekrataal kills one, and Underworld Dreams and Consume Spirit drain them out.

decks.name: Lofty Heights
decks.plan: Blue flyers and control: Wind Drakes and Mahamoti Djinn in the air, Confiscate and Puppeteer for tempo, and Telepathy to see their hand.

decks.name: World Aflame
decks.plan: Red land destruction: Stone Rain and Demolish slow them down, Wildfire resets the board, and Magnivore grows from every sorcery.

decks.name: Gold Starter Deck
decks.plan: Ninth Edition's red-green starter: the same Baloths and Wurms, plus the Gold advanced pack's Craw Wurm, Anaba Shaman and Dancing Scimitar. Burn the blockers and swing big.

decks.name: Silver Starter Deck
decks.plan: Ninth Edition's white-blue starter with its Silver advanced pack: stall the ground with Coral Eels and Giant Octopus, take to the air with Wind Drake, and play with their hand revealed thanks to Telepathy.

decks.name: Expulsion
decks.plan: Black discard: Ravenous Rats, Megrim and Disrupting Scepter punish every discard, and Abyssal Specter keeps it coming.

decks.name: Heavy Hitters
decks.plan: Green giants: elves and Rampant Growth ramp into Llanowar Behemoth, Primeval Force and Rhox.

decks.name: Life Boost
decks.plan: White life gain: Angel of Mercy and Healing Salve gain life, Spirit Link and Blessed Reversal turn combat into more, and Glorious Anthem pumps the team.

decks.name: Sky Slam
decks.plan: Blue flyers: Wind Drakes, Aven Fisher and Air Elemental attack while Mana Leak, Remove Soul and Unsummon protect them.

decks.name: Speed Scorch
decks.plan: Red speed: Raging Goblins and Goblin Chariots attack early, Goblin King pumps them, and Blaze and Lightning Blast finish the job.

decks.name: Gold Starter Deck
decks.plan: Eighth Edition's red-green starter with its Gold advanced pack: Enormous Baloth and Spined Wurm on top of Norwood Rangers and Hill Giants, with Volcanic Hammer, Lava Axe and Stone Rain. Rampant Growth speeds it up and Blanchwood Armor turns any creature into a threat.

decks.name: Silver Starter Deck
decks.plan: Eighth Edition's white-blue starter with its Silver advanced pack: Glory Seekers early, then Giant Octopus and Vizzerdrix. Vengeance kills an attacker, Index sets up your draws, and Sanctimony gains life whenever a red opponent taps a Mountain.

decks.name: Armada
decks.plan: White weenies with healers: Samite and Master Healer prevent damage, Glorious Anthem pumps the team, and Serra's Embrace turns one creature into a flying, vigilant threat.

decks.name: Bomber
decks.plan: Blue tempo: Merfolk Looter and Sage Owl set up draws, Counterspell, Force Spike and Boomerang buy time, and Confiscate steals their best permanent.

decks.name: Decay
decks.plan: Black attrition: Crypt Rats and Corrupt kill creatures, Duress and Mind Rot take cards, and Abyssal Specter and Fallen Angel finish.

decks.name: Infestation
decks.plan: Goblins: Goblin Matron finds Goblin King, Goblin Digging Team breaks walls, and Spitting Earth and Blaze clear the path.

decks.name: Way Wild
decks.plan: Green stompy: elves ramp into Ancient Silverback and Thorn Elemental, and Lure forces the whole board to block one creature.

decks.name: Gold Starter Deck
decks.plan: Red and green beef from the Seventh Edition starter, with its Gold advanced pack added. Bears, Orggs and a Spined Wurm trade blows while Volcanic Hammer and Lava Axe clear blockers or go face; Rampant Growth and Llanowar Elves get the big creatures out early and Orcish Oriflamme makes every attack hit harder.

decks.name: Silver Starter Deck
decks.plan: White and blue from the Seventh Edition starter, with its Silver advanced pack added. Knight Errant and Coral Merfolk hold the ground while Giant Octopus and Vizzerdrix arrive; Vengeance kills a tapped attacker, Breath of Life brings back your best creature, and Rod of Ruin pings.

decks.name: Blinding Fury
decks.plan: Mono-white knights and angels. Knight Errant and Charging Paladin attack early, Archangel and Angel of Light take over the air, and Armageddon destroys every land once you're ahead on board. False Peace skips their combat when you need a breather.

decks.name: Deadly Instinct
decks.plan: Black disruption. Ravenous Rats and Mind Rot empty their hand, Hand of Death and Dakmor Plague kill creatures, and Soul Feast drains 4 to close it out. Gravedigger rebuys your best creature.

decks.name: Goblin Assault
decks.plan: A Goblin swarm. Raging Goblins and Goblin Chariots attack from the first turns, Goblin General pumps the whole team, Relentless Assault gives you a second combat, and Volcanic Hammer, Scorching Spear and Lava Axe burn the rest.

decks.name: Impaler
decks.plan: Green beef that ignores blockers. Lone Wolf, Pride of Lions and Thorn Elemental can deal their damage as though they weren't blocked, Norwood Archers hold off flyers, and Whirlwind wipes the skies clean.

decks.name: Time Curse
decks.plan: Blue control. Remove Soul and Counterspell stop creatures, Extinguish stops sorceries, Exhaustion keeps their board tapped, and Time Warp takes an extra turn. Air Elementals and Wind Drakes win in the air.

decks.name: Starter Deck 1
decks.plan: Starter 1999's first deck: Goblins, Elves and Zombies with Hand of Death and Lava Axe. Coercion strips their best card, and Trained Orgg and Ogre Warrior bring the size.

decks.name: Starter Deck 2
decks.plan: Starter 1999's second deck: flyers (Wind Drake, Sea Eagle, Royal Falcon, Wild Griffin) backed by Vizzerdrix and Giant Octopus. Time Ebb and Eye Spy disrupt, and Breath of Life recovers your best creature.

decks.name: Starter Deck 1
decks.plan: Portal's first starter deck: three colors of simple beaters, from Raging Goblin to Hill Giant and Regal Unicorn, with Volcanic Hammer, Blaze and Lava Axe to burn blockers or the opponent. Defiant Stand rescues a blocker when you're attacked.

decks.name: Starter Deck 2
decks.plan: Portal's second starter: blue flyers like Snapping Drake, black removal like Hand of Death and Vampiric Touch, and green bodies such as Panther Warriors. Command of Unsummoning bounces two attackers mid-combat and Gravedigger rebuys a creature.
